job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities




As a Backend Engineer, youll design, build, and maintain the server-side systems that power our applications. You’ll focus on how data is stored, processed, and served via APIs—ensuring our services are performant, secure, reliable, and scalable.

Key responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain backend services like procedure/functions linked to APIs for integrations.

- Build and optimise data models, database queries, and storage strategies.

- Ensure high performance and reliability through profiling, monitoring, and tuning.

- Implement secure-by-design practices (authentication/authorisation, data protection, secure coding).

- Design scalable architectures and contribute to system design decisions.

- Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code; contribute to code reviews and engineering standards.

- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive preventative improvements.

- Collaborate with frontend engineers, product, QA, and platform/SRE teams to deliver end-to-end outcomes.

- Document APIs, services, and operational runbooks to support long-term maintainability.

Skills & Experience

- Strong backend engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and distributed systems basics.

- Experience building server-side applications and APIs (REST and/or event-driven patterns).

- Solid understanding of databases like PostgreSQL, indexing, transactions, and data consistency.

- Practical experience with testing strategies (unit/integration), CI/CD, and version control.

- Ability to design systems that handle high throughput and large volumes of operational tasks.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a language-agnostic mindset.

- We’re open to engineers proficient in any of the following: Python, Java, C++, C#, Clojure, CoffeeScript, F#, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, TypeScript, Scala.
